title: A Causal Inference Approach for Evaluating Diagnostic Tests and AI-Enabled Medical Devices: From Effect Modification to Information-Augmented Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2608.19501v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diagnostic medical tests and devices provide useful information for evaluating the potential benefits and risks of therapeutic treatments. However, unlike treatments, their impact on health outcomes is generally indirect because measuring diagnostic information typically does not itself affect patient outcomes, which complicates evaluation of their effectiveness. In this work, we develop a causal inference approach for evaluating diagnostic tests by distinguishing explanatory and pragmatic effectiveness. Explanatory effectiveness evaluates whether a diagnostic test result provides treatment-relevant information beyond baseline covariates by explaining additional treatment-effect heterogeneity, which we characterize using a variance-based treatment-effect variable importance measure. translated_title: 一种评估诊断测试和AI医疗器械的因果推断方法：从效应修饰到信息增强决策
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19501v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：诊断性医学测试和设备为评估治疗方案的潜在益处和风险提供了有用信息。然而，与治疗不同，它们对健康结果的影响通常是间接的，因为获取诊断信息本身通常不会直接影响患者结局，这使评估其有效性变得复杂。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种因果推断方法来评估诊断测试，通过区分解释性有效性和实用性有效性。解释性有效性评估诊断测试结果是否在基线协变量之外提供与治疗相关的信息，通过解释额外的治疗效应异质性，我们使用基于方差的治疗效应变量重要性度量来表征这一点。实用性有效性评估将这些信息纳入个性化治疗决策是否能改善预期结局，这是一个核心问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种因果推断框架，通过区分解释性和实用性有效性，并引入方差基变量重要性度量，系统评估诊断测试和AI医疗器械在个性化治疗决策中的信息价值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a causal inference framework that distinguishes explanatory and pragmatic effectiveness and introduces a variance-based variable importance measure to systematically evaluate the informational value of diagnostic tests and AI-enabled medical devices in personalized treatment decisions.
